title: Cost and token economics: what M1 and F4 taught

cards.title: Know what every request costs
cards.text: Record each model request, price it from a dated table, and show the same totals everywhere.

cards.title: A ledger line per request
cards.text: Four token kinds that don't overlap, the cost stored with its price table, unknown never 0.

cards.title: Input is the bill
cards.text: 150 input tokens to 1 output: the M1 baseline run cost $0.6586, 97% of it input.

cards.title: Caching, measured
cards.text: Two markers and a lifetime from the gaps: the run fell 80%, to $0.1334, with 10 of 10 fixes held.

cards.title: A replay is a known $0
cards.text: Recorded answers played back for nothing; a miss fails rather than asking the model.
